notes.title: BREAKING NEWS: 2020 edition!
notes.content:
(yeah I made the header image in MSpaint what's it to you)

Well guys, it's been a while. How have you all been? I'm fine, myself. Real fine. In fact, *so* fine I've been working on a little something-something that I wanted to show it to everyone.

[h1]This *might* end up being [b][u]Clam Man 2.[/u][/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34426734/b66d6506b73963e28b14e897de3175ac0fe7e9d1.gif[/img]

[h3]The idea is simple. [/h3]Or is it? Yes, it is. The plan is to make it an isometric combatless RPG-lite in which everyone's favorite Clam-based protagonist ends up performing comedy at a (literally) underground comedy club. See, I told you it was simple.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34426734/9d4f9cdcb1833053d6e5a701f0ae6377108ca399.gif[/img]
[h3]
I'm currently working on a prototype demo,[/h3] which I'm hoping to share as soon as its done. There's already a lot of dialogue in the game - one quest is about 15% the length of Clam One.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34426734/ad0895508b1601d634093209b9bd416e7e477998.gif[/img]

[url=https://twitter.com/clam_team]I'm posting more progress on our twitter all the time, so feel free to follow the development there! (@clam_team - this is the handle but you can just click this whole darn thing)[/url]


Thanks all you clammy fans, I'll keep in touch! <3 
//marafrass

notes.title: QUICK UPDATE - WE'RE GETTING THERE - MUSIC IS PRETTY COOL
notes.content:
[h1][u][b]Hey everyone! [/b][/u][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34426734/5e9968e6ffbb361ba6ff71130dfc99ce1b0de8c4.png[/img]
Here's a quick update because we've been super quiet lately:

[list]
[*]  The game is coming along real nicely! Right now, we're fixing bugs, adding sound effects and polishing dialogue. We're well on time though.
[*]  Our composer has finished about 60% of the soundtrack so far, and we're super excited about how it's turning out. We can't wait for you guys to hear it.
[*] To all our Indiegogo backers: Most of your rewards, such as items and portraits, are in the game already!
[/list]

That's all from me for now. Gonna go back to doing important dev stuff.

See you guys later!

Clam Man & Team Clam
